subject: Post-call: FinWise performance/SLO recap + customer-led load test coordination
messages:
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 14:03:00 -0700
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finwise.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Subject: Post-call: FinWise performance/SLO recap + customer-led load test coordination

Hi Alex / Priya - thanks again for a productive discovery call today. Quick recap of what we agreed and next steps so we can get the customer-led load test scheduled: 

Summary of SLO targets you mentioned:
- Latency: 95th percentile end-to-end generation latency <= 250 ms for short queries (~64 tokens)
- Throughput: baseline 200 requests/sec sustained for 15m windows; short bursts to 400 rps for up to 2m allowed
- Concurrency: target concurrency of ~100 simultaneous streams/users
- Streaming: require token-by-token streaming (SSE/websocket) for final UX; want start-of-response within 50ms of model generation start

Test logistics / items we need from FinWise to run your customer-led load test:
1) Confirm test window (UTC) - suggested slot: Wed 2027-06-17 02:00-01:00 UTC (low production traffic).
2) Provide a list of client IP addresses to allowlist on our side (we will also provide our egress IPs).
3) Confirm whether you'll run k6 or Locust. If k6, please use the attached k6 script as a starting point (finwise-k6-script-v1.js).
4) We will provision a test account and credentials - see attached instructions (redwood-test-account-instructions.pdf).
5) If you need any temporary increased capacity or a specific model variant, flag it now so we can reserve Dedicated capacity.

Proposed next steps:
- Alex/Priya: confirm test window and which tool you'll run (k6 vs Locust) + provide IPs to whitelist
- Redwood (Marissa / Aditya): provision test account, share credentials, provide egress IP list, and load-test runbook
- Quick prep call on Wed 2027-06-16 16:00 UTC optional to validate script and monitoring dashboards

I've attached the k6 sample script and the instructions doc. Happy to jump on a 20-min call to walk through the script before the run.

Thanks,
Logan
Director, Solutions - Redwood Inference

Attachments: finwise-k6-script-v1.js; redwood-test-account-instructions.pdf

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 17:12:00 -0400
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finwise.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finwise.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinWise performance/SLO recap + customer-led load test coordination

Logan - thanks for the clear recap. Confirming a few details from our side: 

- We can target the proposed window Wed 2027-06-17 02:00-01:00 UTC. That works for our infra team.
- Tooling: we'll run k6 for the main RPS/concurrency runs and a small Locust job for end-to-end browser-style flows. We'll start with your k6 script and adapt it.
- SLO clarifications: the 95p <= 250ms target is for API response time (end of generation). For streaming, we care primarily about first-chunk latency (<50ms) and steady-state token throughput (tokens/sec).
- Expected workload: our target is 200rps sustained for 15m with 100 concurrent clients, and two 2-minute bursts up to 400rps.

Action from FinWise (we'll do before Wed):
- Priya will share the list of external IPs to whitelist for our k6 runners (and the Locust controller).
- We'll validate the attached k6 script and send any tweaks by EOD Wed.

Could you confirm the Redwood egress IP ranges and the test account credentials timeline? Also, can you confirm whether we need any special header/token for streaming vs non-streaming calls?

-Alex
Senior SRE, FinWise

Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 09:05:00 -0700
From: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finwise.com>, Priya Singh <priya.singh@finwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinWise performance/SLO recap + customer-led load test coordination

Alex - thanks. Quick answers: 

- Redwood egress IPs to whitelist: 34.216.12.10, 34.216.12.11, 34.216.12.12 (we will confirm if any additional ranges are required once capacity is reserved).
- Test account timeline: we will provision and email credentials by Tue 2027-06-16 20:00 UTC. Credentials and runbook attached.
- Streaming vs non-streaming: streaming uses the same API key but requires the "stream=true" query param (or the streaming flag in the SDK). No additional header required. We recommend using our SSE endpoint for token-by-token streaming in k6; see the attached instructions.

I've attached the k6 script again with a small comment about connection keep-alive and token chunk size. Please confirm the final script by EOD Tue so we can review in the prep call if you want.

Prep call reminder: Wed 2027-06-16 16:00 UTC (20 minutes) - join link in calendar invite (sent separately).

Thanks,
Logan

Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 11:18:00 -0700
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
Subject: Internal: FinWise load test - provisioning & ops notes

Looping in infra/ops to confirm provisioning and monitoring: 

- Aditya: please provision the FinWise test account per the instructions and generate API key with scope limited to the test project. Share creds to Alex/Priya via the secure link (Doc/Drive link below).
- Rishi: please reserve two extra instances (Dedicated) for Wed 06/17 02:00-01:00 UTC to ensure capacity for burst testing; enable verbose tracing for the run (sampling 1%). Pre-warm model cache 30 mins before start.
- Monitoring: dashboard is at https://redwood-console.example.com/dashboards/finwise-loadtest - set alert for 95p latency > 300ms.

I'll create the runbook in the shared Drive and upload the final k6 script if Alex sends his tweaks.

Marissa
Principal Solutions Engineer - Redwood Inference

Related links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/finwise-loadtest-runbook

Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 09:42:00 -0700
From: Priya Singh <priya.singh@finwise.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan.wright@redwood.ai>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finwise.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Subject: Re: Post-call: FinWise performance/SLO recap + customer-led load test coordination

Thanks everyone - quick status update before tomorrow's run: 

- We have whitelisted Redwood egress IPs (34.216.12.10-12) on our firewall and verified connectivity.
- We tested the k6 script with a small pilot (10 rps) and the streaming handshake looks good. We made a minor tweak to the VU ramp timing and sent the updated script to Logan and Marissa (attached to this thread).
- We received the test account credentials and validated token-based auth for both streaming and non-streaming paths.

We'll kick off the full run tomorrow Wed 2027-06-17 02:00 UTC. We'll upload raw k6 output (JSON) to the shared drive and post a short summary in this thread after the run. If we see >5% errors or 95p > 300ms we'll pause and coordinate with Redwood on next steps.

Appreciate the coordination - Priya will be online during the entire window and Alex will join for the first 30 minutes.

Best,
Priya Singh
SRE Lead, FinWise
